hazards.control: Stay clear of flowlines and iron under flow; restraints on temporary lines.
No ignition sources at the tree; grounding on the flowline.

name: Flowline connection
function: The flanged elbow and drop leg that takes flow from the choke down to the buried flowline toward the facility.

tabs.overview: Flanged to the choke; drops to grade and runs to the header or the separator; check valve and pressure sensor on the line.
tabs.engineering: Flowline class per the facility design.
tabs.safety: Line of fire under flow; grounding.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
